snippet.title: JunkRats - Teaser
snippet.description:
JunkRats is our new game we've been working on here at NSCG and are excited to show off the first teaser for our co-op horror game.

Game Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1495770/JunkRats?utm_source=YouTube
Website: https://www.notsoclassicgames.com/
Patreon: https://patreon.com/NotSoClassicGames

Feel free to share the video and join us on our Discord to show your support.
https://discord.gg/JcfeNDnC5k
